title: AWS Cloud Practitioner Bootcamp
description: A two-day, exam-focused bootcamp covering the four domains of the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam: cloud concepts, security and compliance, core services, and billing. Day two ends with a timed mock exam and a walkthrough of every answer.

title: Serverless Day: Build a REST API with Lambda and API Gateway
venue: Computer Lab 3, Block B, GCET and live on YouTube
description: Hands-on workshop where you build and deploy a to-do API using AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway and DynamoDB, all inside the AWS Free Tier. Bring a laptop with Node.js 20+ installed and an AWS account ready.

title: Intro to Cloud: Deploy Your First Website on Amazon S3
description: Our orientation session for first-years. Attendees created an AWS account, set up billing alarms, and published a static portfolio site on Amazon S3 with CloudFront in front of it.
